name: drop-terminal-owner
oracle: An admitted failure must retain its original source and lease root.

name: drop-source
oracle: Terminal state must keep the exact authenticated source, not merely the lease.

name: omit-native-admission
oracle: An ambiguous VA attempt requires custody even before a record or lease returns.

name: late-input-admission
oracle: A genuine existing lease must survive rejection of malformed source metadata.

name: omit-gpu-prefix
oracle: Retain the exact returned GPU-map prefix, including zero and overshoot.

name: skip-final-map
oracle: Successful initialization requires the real final map and both currentness checks before retagging.

name: omit-in-place-quarantine
oracle: An external owner must see immediate quarantine on native unwind without relying on standalone settlement.
